title.narrative: East Africa Community Seed and Plant Varieties Bill advocacy project

description.narrative:
BIBA-Kenya, a member of our partner AFSA, will prepare a policy position paper on the East Africa Community’s proposed new Plant Variety and Seed Bill. The position paper will be a key resource for CAFOD’s advocacy work on seed sovereignty in Africa, enabling the continuation of work on this issue with partners across the region.
To inform the policy position paper, BIBA Kenya will convene strategic multi-stakeholder forums to enhance awareness, dialogue, and advocacy capacity among CSOs, farmer networks, and the public on the implications of the EAC Seed and Plant Variety Bill to seed sovereignty and biodiversity in East Africa. This will build awareness, bring farmers' perspectives into the policy analysis and strengthen collaboration and joint advocacy among CSOs across EAC countries for inclusive and equitable seed governance.
BIBA Kenya will coordinate the forums in collaboration with regional and national partners. The process will combine virtual and in-person engagements, participatory learning, and dialogue-based facilitation. BIBA-K has secured funding and in-kind support to convene these forums from AFSA, which has member organisations across the countries of the EAC.
The outcomes of these forums will inform the development of the policy position paper, ensuring that farmers' perspectives are fully represented in advocacy messages, and recommendations for submission to EAC legislators.
